---
title: Markdown-looking stdout remains text
---

# Markdown-looking stdout remains text

Stream output must be escaped and displayed verbatim, even when it resembles
authored Markdown.

```{python}
#| label: markdown-looking-stdout
print(
    "# Not a heading\n\n"
    "[Not a link](https://example.invalid)\n\n"
    "```{python}\nraise RuntimeError('stdout must stay inert')\n```"
)
```
